Since the draft EIS asked for comments on this matter and potential problems were indicated, future AFES's will consider the noise level problem in depth as the noise producers indicated by FEA, Ford, IH, and AMC are included in the scenarios for future AFES's. AMC was the only manufacturer to raise the issue on mufflers. If more complete substantive data is provided, the problem, which may be general to all motor vehicles, can be addressed. NHTSA does not envision this to be a problem for the MY 1979 AFES.

American Motors Corporation (AMC). ANC claims that NHTSA neglected to account for all the problems inherent in the certification process. AMC points out that the provisions of the Selective Enforcement Auditing procedures (SEA), which became effective for model year 1977, effectively require continuous monitoring of emissions levels of all vehicle configurations in order to maintain certification. AMC believes the Agency has oversimplified the potential impact of the regulation on air quality.
